method: Batch 87 (mobrec87, witchfight): the batch 45 creeperwitch harness (unticked probe player, row element 5 [explosions, spawned, changed cells, player motion], witch flags [drinking, timer, held potion, movement speed]) where the EntityPotion entities a witch throws also update, after the mobs in spawn order (World.loadedEntityList: one thrown this tick updates in the same pass): EntityThrowable.onUpdate, the hit on the player and EntityPotion.onImpact. Row element 6 is [[potion index, x, y, z, motion x, y, z, dead] for each potion that updated, [the player active effects [id, duration, amplifier]]]. The player is never ticked, so its effects never run out and its hurt timer never falls: the witch picks slowness (8 blocks or more, no slowness), poison (no poison), then harming. fight: a witch 10 and 7 blocks away; melee: the player blows (1 damage: the unticked player attack attribute never takes the held sword modifier) at ticks 30 and 90 (it drinks healing while hurt), then a blow kills it at tick 141 (drops, orbs). Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
